# Arch Enviornmental Group LLC

> Independent environmental testing and inspections in Kingsburg, CA.

Arch Enviornmental Group LLC is an independent environmental testing and inspection company serving Kingsburg and communities across California's Central Valley since 2026. We provide mold, indoor air quality, asbestos, lead, water quality, and radon testing, plus clearance testing, environmental site assessments, and compliance consulting — every assessment backed by accredited laboratory analysis and a clear written report. Because we don't perform the remediation ourselves, our findings are independent. Phone: (559) 296-2088 · Email: info@archenviroservice.com.
